issue_context.title: Wildly inconsistent documentation on Dir2 <-> Rot2 conversion methods.
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/d7080369a7471e6aa9747bad41a4469092f9967b/crates/bevy_math/src/direction.rs#L219-L245

```rust
    /// Get the rotation that rotates this direction to the Y-axis.
    #[inline]
    pub fn rotation_from_y(self) -> Rot2 {
```
This docstring is imho completely backwards to what it should say, notably, it is backwards to what the docstring for `rotation_from_x` says.

## Solution

Figure out which way the methods *actually* go, and update the docstrings appropriately. (Imo the semantics on the x-axis functions are correct, and the doc strings on the y-axis functions are wrong.)
comments: Yeah it looks like I made a copy-paste error here, the docs for the `x` versions should be correct.

review_comments:
Question: would it be clearer and/or easier to remember if we used the term "from" in the docs?
```suggestion
    /// Get the rotation that rotates to this direction from the Y-axis.
```
I tried this out, but I found that it makes the wording a little weird between the `to/from` method docs, so I think I'm going to leave it alone for now.
